claims.statement: Most major computer failures start at the handoffs between teams or system layers, not inside individual parts.
The culprit is usually an unwritten guess crossing a boundary, such as which physical units a number uses.
When every boundary guess is written down and machine-checked, fixing one problem stays fixed without breaking upper layers.

three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about fix unwritten guesses between teams.
Most major computer failures start at the handoffs between teams or system layers, not inside individual parts.
The culprit is usually an unwritten guess crossing a boundary, such as which physical units a number uses.
When every boundary guess is written down and machine-checked, fixing one problem stays fixed without breaking upper layers.

Clear math and public price records checked every number.
